notes.note: #2998 part 2a second security fix round: the migration freezes each pre-d1 plugin with its digest and grandfathers only matching bytes, the journal (new compare-and-set witness API with frozen candidates and a shared 1024 bound) is written before the file, the legacy update route and installs run the migration first, and whether an earlier record carries its tier is decided under the content lock from the record and the installed bytes. Scanned this document for installation-journal, catalog, update, transaction and on-disk-state claims; none is contradicted (grants, consent, renderer selection and success responses are unchanged).
